thread:
Morgan Lee: hey folks — pushed fixes for the audit-log leak in PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1234. addressed the null-check comment and added a unit test for the edge case. ptal when you have a sec; trying to get this merged before Friday's canary window.
Alex Chen: thanks — quick Q: did you run the e2e? CircleCI shows a flaky timeout on storage integration in the last run.
Morgan Lee: yeah ran e2e locally and they pass. the CI flake is in storage/retry_test — I added a small retry in the CI config and triggered a rerun: `/retest`.
CI Bot: build #7890 retriggered by Morgan Lee — running tests.
Jordan Patel: left one small nit inline about using debug vs info for that log; otherwise LGTM. can you squash the fix into the main commit?
Morgan Lee: squashed and pushed, added a short changelog entry. question: should I merge as soon as CI is green or hold until the canary window?
Alex Chen: if the canary is tomorrow i'd prefer we merge after CI and schedule a 10% canary rollout first. don't want to block you though — what's the perf impact? :thinking_face:
Morgan Lee: perf tests show ~0.5% CPU increase per GPU at peak, so pretty negligible. I can do staged rollout: 10% -> 50% after 30m if metrics look stable -> 100% after another 30m.
Jordan Patel: @Alex Chen if you can give an approve i'll merge after CI passes; otherwise i'll hold for the scheduled canary slot.
Alex Chen: approving now. :thumbsup:
CI Bot: build #7890: all tests passed — merging in 2m.
Morgan Lee: merged. thanks all. i'll monitor canary metrics and post a quick summary in #eng-sre if anything looks off. :rocket:
